_readme: God powers. A student earns a god's power by writing an evidence card (a claim about the god + a quotation from the text) that the teacher approves.
Approved powers belong to the student; their whole alliance can use them in monster battles.
prompt: what the evidence card asks for. Replace these with the old god chart prompts if you prefer.
key must stay the same once students have cards (it links their cards to the god).

gods.name: Zeus
gods.prompt: Make a claim about how Zeus uses his power as king of the gods. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Hera
gods.prompt: Make a claim about what Hera values or how she treats those who wrong her. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Poseidon
gods.prompt: Make a claim about Poseidon's temper or his rule over the sea. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Demeter
gods.prompt: Make a claim about how Demeter's feelings affect the world. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Athena
gods.prompt: Make a claim about how Athena helps or tests heroes. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Apollo
gods.prompt: Make a claim about Apollo's gifts (prophecy, music, light) and how he uses them. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Artemis
gods.prompt: Make a claim about what Artemis protects and how she punishes those who cross her. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Ares
gods.prompt: Make a claim about how the other gods see Ares, or how he fights. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Aphrodite
gods.prompt: Make a claim about how Aphrodite's power changes what mortals or gods do. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Hephaestus
gods.prompt: Make a claim about how Hephaestus is treated, or what his craft makes possible. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Hermes
gods.prompt: Make a claim about Hermes's cleverness or his role as messenger. Quote the text that proves it.

gods.name: Hades
gods.prompt: Make a claim about how Hades rules the Underworld, or how he is different from the other gods. Quote the text that proves it.
